description: v7 main PCB passive power-path probe points (PWR-001). Black lead home: G = TP4.

blocks.text: v7 main board, top side. Hold it with the USB-C socket on the left edge.
Zoom 1: charger side, by the USB-C socket and the battery holder's + end

markers.label: A
markers.legend: A: test pad TP3 (USB power after the fuse, Protected_VBUS)

markers.label: B
markers.legend: B: C25, the end away from the board edge (BQ_PMID)

markers.label: C
markers.legend: C: C24, the end away from the board edge (BQ_REGN)

markers.label: D
markers.legend: D: big can C30, its + leg (BAT_RAW, battery side)

markers.label: H
markers.legend: H: Q2 pin 3, the lone pin, drain (VBAT)

blocks.text: Zoom 2: system rail, ground pad and the 3.3 V regulator

markers.label: G
markers.legend: G: test pad TP4 = GROUND. Black lead lives here.

markers.label: N
markers.legend: N: U8 pin 3, the leg nearest the USB-C edge (+5V)

blocks.text: Zoom 3: boost converter area and the power switch SW1

markers.label: L
markers.legend: L: C41, the end nearer SW1 (VSYS_SENSE)

markers.label: M
markers.legend: M: SW1, the pin circled (BOOST_EN): the middle one of the three pins on this side, sitting close to the right-hand pin

markers.label: Q
markers.legend: Q: C33, the end away from SW1 (boost VCC)

markers.label: R
markers.legend: R: R40, the circled end (boost FB). Its other end is GND

blocks.text: Rendered from the v7 KiCad layout (commit {commit}). Pin positions are from the layout file, so check under the loupe before probing.
